scope: Design reassessment and inexpensive conditional diagnostics; no GPU experiment or new training launched by this research request.

gates.purpose: Optional frozen training/native numerical implementation sanity check; distinct from already-tested actual-prefix teacher-relabel training
gates.decision: Investigate identified material discrepancies without inferring a bug from bitwise inequality alone. No repeat of Parallel_T0/T1 training.
gates.reuse: Prior P0 numerical-check design remains unstarted; completed actual-prefix training evidence is already available.
gates.condition: Concrete evidence of a material implementation discrepancy; otherwise skip. Not a prerequisite for G1/G2.

gates.purpose: Does earlier actual prefix distinguish otherwise identical current-X states with valuable T1 target differences?
gates.method: Keep the initial DFlash forward unchanged; compare plausible earlier branches sharing the last token at j>=2. Current hidden/raw q/support must remain equal. Obtain teacher only online, report branch probability/reach and target/action separation. Do not inject tokens into the frozen draft mask.
readout: pair TV and actual action disagreement
gates.stop_if: Branches have negligible reach or low incremental task value; do not fabricate conflicts to consume the request budget.
gates.boundary: Balanced-pair TV bound is conditional, not a global AL estimate. T0 has one correct reached path from fixed context; off-path pairs do not establish its bottleneck.

gates.purpose: Predict finite task value using deployment-visible inputs
gates.condition: G1 shows non-negligible useful prefix information; otherwise select a different information probe. G0 is optional and only triggered by concrete implementation-discrepancy evidence.
gates.method: Cross-prompt current-X versus short actual-prefix-X+ lightweight probe with matched capacity and shuffled-older-prefix control; retain the actual last token. Evaluate finite action value and harm, not coefficient MSE only.
gates.new_training: Small auxiliary probes only if this later experiment is authorized; online states released, no persistent vectors
gates.decision: No promotion for training fit or gradient-MSE reduction alone.
secondary_checks: multiplicative gate response/saturation and error association
same-state T0/T1 finite-action tradeoff before adding mode conditioning

gates.purpose: Is explicit NO_EDIT predictable and does it justify its execution cost?
gates.method: Fixed SHORT/LONG/Parallel_TF diagnostic first; compare realized RAW versus REPAIR incremental task value, include correct states and first position. Calibrate by mode on separate development prompts.
gates.stop_if: Optimistic selection ceiling is small, benefit is not predictable, or branch/compaction cost consumes it.
gates.boundary: Oracle gating is not deployable performance; dose approaching zero does not remove compute; C40 routing can cost more.

gates.condition: Incremental finite-action value and cross-prompt prediction evidence from G2 or GS
gates.method: Keep existing basis and Parallel_TF context backbone; vary one justified factor. Match data, order, anchors, precision and initialization contract. No original short-N retraining implied.
gates.stop_if: Only training fit improves or originally-correct states are increasingly harmed.
gates.boundary: Fresh pilot controls and historical N are not automatically the same-panel causal comparison. Do not conflate structural, basis and loss changes.

gates.purpose: Native rollout and production execution value
gates.condition: G3 or a justified training-free execution change passes correctness
gates.method: Candidate follows its own actual prefixes. Separate instrumented capture=False cost attribution from clean observer-free formal C1/C40. Verifier consumes the actual chosen proposal.
gates.decision: Promotion depends on native task gain and net TPS in the claimed mode; T1-only gain can support a T1-only claim, not universal improvement.
constraints: Use an empty whole card; target and draft colocated
Record foreign processes and contamination without terminating them
Do not use smoke as a speed result

gates.purpose: Stage a single candidate before full long training
gates.condition: G4 passes and source/conversation split contract fixed
gates.method: Measure throughput on the new data and obtain early learning curves; reuse intermediate checkpoints, expand one candidate conditionally. Reserve an untouched final test. No automatic 500k x 3 or multi-arm full launch.
gates.stop_if: New data does not show transfer of finite/native value, curve plateaus or cost dominates gain.
gates.boundary: Old 10k recovery run is a meaningful positive reference, not a pure dataset-scaling experiment.
